liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I've Been All Around This World** (1 review): Reviewer singles out this song as having a nice live sound with clear instruments [6]
- **Heaven Help The Fool** (1 review): Described as jazzy and extremely well jammed, though the set is looser than the next night's [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-10-18.133594.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 32 songs; 210 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd80-10-18.neumann.vernon.13596.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 32 songs; 204 min; rated 3.14/5 by 14 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording gives a realistic, true-to-the-room perception, like having a virtual seat in the theater; Sits close to crowd yells and claps, but instruments are clear with good bass and a live feel; Audience tapes of the acoustic sets are difficult to enjoy because of sound quality [5][6][7][11][12]
- **gd1980-10-18.135529.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 32 songs; 211 min [2]

## Around the show

- Show was the band's return to New Orleans ten years after the January 1970 Bourbon Street drug bust mentioned in Truckin' [10]
- Reviewer saw the acoustic set then the electric set; believes band had been kept from New Orleans for about a decade [15]
- Acoustic breaks are more creative than in New York and San Francisco; set is less tight than 10/19 [7]
- Electric sets are a little better than in San Francisco, with album-recording pressure absent [12]
- Of four New Orleans shows the reviewer attended, this first one and the others were not mind-bendingly spectacular [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-10-18.133594.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> AIFF [1]. Also: Uploader's notes list Neumann KM84 microphones and say all disc changes are seamless [1]
- **gd80-10-18.neumann.vernon.13596.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Neumann KM84 [3]. Also: Per Betty Cantor-Jackson interview, no soundboard was recorded; the recording gear was being moved from San Francisco to New York [8]
- **gd1980-10-18.135529.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> AIFF [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Peter Simon Grateful Dead: [1980-10-18 Saenger Performing Arts Center, New Orleans, LA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1980-10-18-saenger-performing-arts-center-new-orleans-la-usa/) [17]
